title: The phenomenal model of the intentionality relation

statements.text: The phenomenal model of the intentionality relation (PMIR) is a conscious model whose content is an ongoing subject-object relation: the system as a whole, transparently represented to itself, directed at an object-component. It creates the experience of a self in the act of perceiving, knowing or willing, and is what makes consciousness appear from a first-person perspective.

defines: phenomenal model of the intentionality relation

sources.quote: its content is an ongoing, episodic subject–object-relation
continuously co-representing the representational relation itself
